It is described as a mathematical function that quantifies the difference between the predicted and actual outcomes in machine learning algorithms.


$$\Huge \text{MSE} = \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^{n} (y_i - \hat{y}_i)^2$$

**Variable breakdown:**
* $n$ = total number of data points
* $y_i$ = actual / target value for the $i$-th instance
* $\hat{y}_i$ = predicted value generated by the model for the $i$-th instance
